Project's HDFS UDF path

Task instance batch number of the instance generated
Task code of the task which refers to this variable
Instance code of the task instance which refers to this variable

Business time of the task instance.Business time is defined as the starting time of the task's frequency cycle.    If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM    For daily task the business time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00    For weekly task the business time is the Monday 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-05-31 00:00:00    For monthly task, the business time is 0AM of 1st day of the month of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-01 00:00:00    For hourly task, the business time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
Date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210603
Previous month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202105
Previous date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210531
Previous hour of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMddhh, e.g. 2021053109
Year of the current task instance business time, format yyyy, e.g. 2020
Month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202005
Date of the current task instance business time, format dd, e.g. 30
Hour of the current task instance business time , format hh, eg: 18

The time of a day a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched. If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the scheduled time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the schedule time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd. The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.

The time of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met. If the start run time is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the start run time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the start run time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.

--********************************************************************--
-- Author:              wei.tao@shopee.com
-- Created Time:        2025-08-20
-- Theme Domain：       Anti-fraud 日志数据策略feature - dws 层
-- Description:         https://jira.shopee.io/browse/SPFDT-54753
-- Data Granularity:    
-- Change Log:
--********************************************************************--

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS risk_report.dws_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_gpshex${n}_short_agg_feature_trx_di;
CREATE TABLE risk_report.dws_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_gpshex${n}_short_agg_feature_trx_di (
    flow_no STRING COMMENT '流水号',

    -- 请求用户数特征（req系列）
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_1hr BIGINT COMMENT '近1小时内的不同用户注册请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_3hr BIGINT COMMENT '近3小时内的不同用户注册请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_12hr BIGINT COMMENT '近12小时内的不同用户注册请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_24hr BIGINT COMMENT '近24小时内的不同用户注册请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_2d BIGINT COMMENT '近2天内的不同用户注册请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_7d BIGINT COMMENT '近7天内的不同用户注册请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_15d BIGINT COMMENT '近15天内的不同用户注册请求数',

    -- 激活用户数特征（act系列）
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_1hr BIGINT COMMENT '近1小时内的不同用户注册激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_3hr BIGINT COMMENT '近3小时内的不同用户注册激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_12hr BIGINT COMMENT '近12小时内的不同用户注册激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_24hr BIGINT COMMENT '近24小时内的不同用户注册激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_2d BIGINT COMMENT '近2天内的不同用户注册激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_7d BIGINT COMMENT '近7天内的不同用户注册激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_15d BIGINT COMMENT '近15天内的不同用户注册激活数',

    -- 批量注册请求用户数特征（req_batch系列）
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_1hr BIGINT COMMENT '近1小时内的不同批量注册用户请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_3hr BIGINT COMMENT '近3小时内的不同批量注册用户请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_12hr BIGINT COMMENT '近12小时内的不同批量注册用户请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_24hr BIGINT COMMENT '近24小时内的不同批量注册用户请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_2d BIGINT COMMENT '近2天内的不同批量注册用户请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_7d BIGINT COMMENT '近7天内的不同批量注册用户请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_15d BIGINT COMMENT '近15天内的不同批量注册用户请求数',

    -- 批量注册激活用户数特征（trx_batch系列）
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_1hr BIGINT COMMENT '近1小时内的不同批量注册用户激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_3hr BIGINT COMMENT '近3小时内的不同批量注册用户激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_12hr BIGINT COMMENT '近12小时内的不同批量注册用户激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_24hr BIGINT COMMENT '近24小时内的不同批量注册用户激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_2d BIGINT COMMENT '近2天内的不同批量注册用户激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_7d BIGINT COMMENT '近7天内的不同批量注册用户激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_15d BIGINT COMMENT '近15天内的不同批量注册用户激活数'
)
COMMENT 'risk mart summary table'
PARTITIONED BY (
   grass_date STRING
)
STORED AS parquet
tblproperties
(
    "orc.compress" = "zstd"
)
location '${HDFS_PATH}/dwd/dws_risk_reg_group_fraud_gpshex${n}_short_agg_feature_trx_di/grass_region=${grass_region}';


with no_reactivate as (
SELECT 
    base.flow_no,
    
    -- 请求用户数特征 (req系列) - 基于精确秒级时间窗口
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 3600  -- 1小时 = 3600秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_1hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 10800  -- 3小时 = 10800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_3hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 43200  -- 12小时 = 43200秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_12hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 86400  -- 1天 = 86400秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_24hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 172800  -- 2天 = 172800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_2d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 604800  -- 7天 = 604800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_7d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 1296000  -- 15天 = 1296000秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_15d,
        
    -- 激活用户数特征 (act系列) - 基于精确秒级时间窗口
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 3600  -- 1小时 = 3600秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_1hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 10800  -- 3小时 = 10800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_3hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 43200  -- 12小时 = 43200秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_12hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 86400  -- 1天 = 86400秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_24hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 172800  -- 2天 = 172800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
             
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_2d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 604800  -- 7天 = 604800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_7d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 1296000  -- 15天 = 1296000秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_15d,
  
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 3600  -- 1小时 = 3600秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_1hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 10800  -- 3小时 = 10800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_3hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 43200  -- 12小时 = 43200秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_12hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 86400  -- 1天 = 86400秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_24hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 172800  -- 2天 = 172800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_2d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 604800  -- 7天 = 604800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_7d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 1296000  -- 15天 = 1296000秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_15d,
        
    -- 激活用户数特征 (act系列) - 基于精确秒级时间窗口
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 3600  -- 1小时 = 3600秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_1hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 10800  -- 3小时 = 10800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_3hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 43200  -- 12小时 = 43200秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_12hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 86400  -- 1天 = 86400秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_24hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 172800  -- 2天 = 172800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_2d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 604800  -- 7天 = 604800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_7d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 1296000  -- 15天 = 1296000秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_15d

FROM 
(
    select distinct flow_no,platform_user_id,req_time, app_id, scene_id,gpshex${n},grass_date
    from risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_feature_trx_base_di base
    WHERE base.grass_date = '${ds}'
        AND base.app_id in ('kredit', 'spj', 'spjup') -- bcl/spl/scl
) base
LEFT JOIN 
(   
    select distinct app_id, scene_id, gpshex${n}, platform_user_id,
        req_time, end_result, is_batch_registration, is_reactivate
    from risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_gpshexn_trx_di
    where grass_date >= date('${ds}') - interval '15' day  -- 只需15天数据
        AND grass_date <= '${ds}'
        AND app_id in ('kredit', 'spj', 'spjup') -- bcl/spl/scl
        AND is_reactivate = 0
) as h
ON base.gpshex${n} = h.gpshex${n}
    AND if(base.app_id = 'kredit', base.app_id = h.app_id, base.app_id = h.app_id AND base.scene_id = h.scene_id) 
    AND base.platform_user_id != h.platform_user_id
GROUP BY base.flow_no
)

,has_reactivate as (
SELECT 
    base.flow_no,
    
    -- 请求用户数特征 (req系列) - 基于精确秒级时间窗口
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 3600  -- 1小时 = 3600秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_1hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 10800  -- 3小时 = 10800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_3hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 43200  -- 12小时 = 43200秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_12hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 86400  -- 1天 = 86400秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_24hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 172800  -- 2天 = 172800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_2d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 604800  -- 7天 = 604800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_7d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 1296000  -- 15天 = 1296000秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_15d,
    
    -- 激活用户数特征 (act系列) - 1hr~15d
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 3600  -- 1小时 = 3600秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0             
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_1hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 10800  -- 3小时 = 10800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_3hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 43200  -- 12小时 = 43200秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_12hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 86400  -- 1天 = 86400秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_24hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 172800  -- 2天 = 172800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_2d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 604800  -- 7天 = 604800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_7d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 1296000  -- 15天 = 1296000秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0     
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_15d,
    
    -- 批量注册请求用户数特征 (batch req系列) - 1hr~15d
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 3600  -- 1小时 = 3600秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_1hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 10800  -- 3小时 = 10800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0             
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_3hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 43200  -- 12小时 = 43200秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_12hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 86400  -- 1天 = 86400秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_24hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 172800  -- 2天 = 172800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_2d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 604800  -- 7天 = 604800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_7d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 1296000  -- 15天 = 1296000秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_15d,
    
    -- 批量注册激活用户数特征 (trx_batch系列) - 1hr~15d
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 3600  -- 1小时 = 3600秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_1hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 10800  -- 3小时 = 10800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_3hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 43200  -- 12小时 = 43200秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_12hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 86400  -- 1天 = 86400秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_24hr,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 172800  -- 2天 = 172800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_2d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 604800  -- 7天 = 604800秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_7d,
        
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN base.req_time - h.req_time <= 1296000  -- 15天 = 1296000秒
            AND base.req_time - h.req_time >= 0
            AND h.end_result = 'pass'
            AND h.is_batch_registration = 1
        THEN h.platform_user_id END) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_15d
        
FROM 
(
    select distinct flow_no,platform_user_id,req_time, app_id, scene_id,gpshex${n},grass_date
    from risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_feature_trx_base_di base
    WHERE base.grass_date = '${ds}'
        AND base.app_id not in ('kredit', 'spj', 'spjup') -- bcl/spl/scl
) base
LEFT JOIN 
(   
    select distinct app_id, scene_id, gpshex${n}, platform_user_id,
        req_time, end_result, is_batch_registration, is_reactivate
    from risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_gpshexn_trx_di
    where grass_date >= date('${ds}') - interval '15' day  -- 只需15天数据
        AND grass_date <= '${ds}'
        AND app_id not in ('kredit', 'spj', 'spjup') -- bcl/spl/scl
) as h
ON base.gpshex${n} = h.gpshex${n}
    AND base.app_id = h.app_id
    AND base.scene_id = h.scene_id  
    AND base.platform_user_id != h.platform_user_id
GROUP BY base.flow_no
)

insert overwrite table risk_report.dws_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_gpshex${n}_short_agg_feature_trx_di partition (grass_date = '${ds}')
SELECT *
FROM has_reactivate
WHERE gpshex${n}_reg_req_15d > 0 OR gpshex${n}_reg_trx_15d > 0 OR gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_15d > 0 OR gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_15d > 0
union all
SELECT *
FROM no_reactivate
WHERE gpshex${n}_reg_req_15d > 0 OR gpshex${n}_reg_trx_15d > 0 OR gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_15d > 0 OR gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_15d > 0
;


msck repair table risk_report.dws_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_gpshex${n}_short_agg_feature_trx_di;
refresh table risk_report.dws_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_gpshex${n}_short_agg_feature_trx_di;
